name: quote
title: Quote
description: A pull-quote or testimonial in a native figure: the words, who said them, their role and business, and an optional link to the source. Quiet sets the words beside a hairline with the name in small capitals; warm writes them in the hand as a margin note with a pencil bracket; playful sets them large under a hand-drawn quotation mark that inks in once.
